gates.description: The Greenways OS over Tahto architecture ADR is merged.
greenways-ai/tahto exists with reviewable repository history.
gates.evidence: Tahto is pinned at f2ab5955b4645ebd170838578d5508bb1262ff8b, containing the object vault, immutable history, CAS heads, backup/restore plans, device identity, replay protection and incremental sync planning.

gates.description: Two devices exchange only missing objects, preserve signed divergent heads, create and restore a complete backup, and reject tampering, stale sequences and replayed nonces.
gates.evidence: The pinned Hoplite revision includes bounded request ABI V3 and Nginx request-body binding. The pinned Tahto revision includes object closure, immutable history, backup/restore planning, device enrolment and revocation, durable nonce/idempotency evidence and bounded incremental-sync plans. Atomic durable metadata transactions, an installed signature/freshness provider, object-transfer execution, replay retention compaction and the complete two-device fixture remain outstanding.
